summary: Resolve the crafting-station placement/reachability constraint using a valid adjacent ground cell or an already-placed usable table; once a station is available, continue the existing wooden pickaxe crafting path.
rationale: Continue Active Episode episode-cycle-0001: Unblock the starter tool path by establishing a usable crafting station near the nearby oak logs, then continue toward the wooden pickaxe benchmark only after a valid station is reachable.

evidence_required: evidence that a crafting_table is placed and reachable
inventory or held-item evidence showing wooden_pickaxe
world or inventory evidence confirming no further placement blocker on the chosen station location

stop_conditions: A new valid crafting-station location is found or confirmed reachable.
The actor already has a reachable crafting table and can proceed directly to tool crafting.
A fresh blocker shows the same placement constraint on a different target, requiring parameter repair or a different adjacent cell.
Physical progress for the wooden pickaxe is verified.
